text:
maria: Scheduling a config-only deploy in the 09:00-11:00 UTC change window. Adjusting rate limits, timeouts, routing fallback priority, and continuous-batching params. Canary plan 5% -> 25% over 20m if healthy.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by maria. ID: cfg-20260315-9. Canary: 5% in region us-west1. Steps: apply config, wait 10m, bump to 25% if SLOs OK. No dry-run.

aj: quick q — are we pinning model versions for the canary? I don't want auto-fallback to a different model variant.

maria: yes — pinning to model "rw-infer-v2.1" for this rollout. Added pinning block in the config.

kevin: batch_size change confirmed? dropping from 32 -> 16 to reduce tail latency?

maria: correct. continuous_batching.max_batch_size: 16, max_wait_ms: 8. Also enabling prefetch_kv = true.

sam: Rollback criteria: if p95 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m, rollback to previous config and pin routing to steady pool. Oncall please ack.

oncall-bot: @oncall rules unchanged. Alert created: infra.llm.latency.p95 > 200ms for 5m -> page @oncall. Temporary dashboard panel added: cfg-20260315-9.

olivia: I'll update the release notes + docs. Callout: token_rate_per_minute 1.2M -> 1.5M, plus lowered per-route caps for guest traffic. Will add partner-facing note.

maria: config snippet: 
```yaml
routing:
  priority: ["steady", "burst"]
  fallback: "burst"
limits:
  token_rate_per_minute: 1500000
  per_route:
    guest: 500000
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 60000
  kv_cache_ttl_ms: 300000
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  max_wait_ms: 8
  prefetch_kv: true
pinning:
  model: "rw-infer-v2.1"
  version: "2026-03-15_09"
```

aj: Looks good to me. :thumbsup:

kevin: One more ask — ensure qos shaper enabled for dedicated pools to avoid head-of-line blocking.

maria: added qos_shaper: true. Canary start scheduled for 09:10 UTC. I'll post updates at 25% and final rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:11 UTC (us-west1, 5%). Monitor: latency dashboard, errors, token throughput. Link: https://console/redwood/deploys/cfg-20260315-9

sam: Acked. I'm watching metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 25% at 09:31 UTC. No anomalies observed in the first 20m.

maria: thanks everyone — keeping window open until 11:00 UTC, but plan to finish full rollout earlier if stable.
